li.p: Select SettingsVehicleLightsWelcome mirror/lightOn door unlock or On driver approach on the infotainment system screen. The exterior lights will turn on for approximately 15 seconds.

section.title: Operating condition(s)
section.p: When the lighting switch is turned on (AUTO position operates only at night), and all doors are closed and locked with the vehicle off, press the door unlock button on the smart key or digital key.
